summary: Iteration 28 - Review Indicator and Auto-Advance Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Both bugs are FIXED.

Bug 1 FIXED: Review indicator is NOT clickable as a toggle - clicking it does not change review state

Bug 2B FIXED: After approving last pending guide, toast 'Todas las guías han sido revisadas' appears correctly
Bug 2C FIXED: KPI 'REVISIÓN MANUAL X/Y' updates immediately after approve/reject (11/27 -> 12/27)
Bug 2C FIXED: Segment filter counts update immediately after approve/reject (Pendiente revisión(1) -> (0))
Role-based access: Agent and Proveedor correctly cannot see approve/reject buttons
Role-based access: Agent and Proveedor correctly cannot see Re-sincronizar Kosmo and Evaluar IA todas buttons
PATCH /api/packages/{id}/review endpoint correctly returns 403 for agent and proveedor roles
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review indicator and auto-advance bugs are fixed. The 27-guide journey now has 12 approved and 15 rejected packages (0 pending). KPIs update in real-time via optimistic updates with reviewOverrides state.
